responses: Hello! How can I assist you with your HR queries today?

To apply via the Web Portal:
1. Go to **Leave > Leave Apply**.
2. Select the **Leave Type** and dates.
3. Enter a **Reason** and click **Submit**.

To check your leave status:
1. Go to **Leave > Leave Information > My Leave**.
2. Look at the **Status** column to see if it is **Pending**, **Approved**, or **Rejected**.

To apply for OD:
1. Go to **Attendance > Regularization**.
2. Select the **Date**.
3. Select **On Duty** in the Reason field.
4. Click **Apply**.

To download your payslip:
1. Navigate to **Salary > Payslips**.
2. Select the **Month**.
3. Click the **Download** icon.

To check your balance:
1. Go to **Leave > Balances**.
2. View your **Available**, **Consumed**, and **Granted** leaves.

patterns: Show my total earnings for the year
responses:
To view Year-to-Date earnings:
1. Go to **Salary > YTD Reports**.
2. View your **Gross Earnings** and **Deductions** for the current financial year.

patterns: I want to cancel my leave
responses:
To cancel or withdraw a leave:
1. Go to **Leave > Leave Information > My Leave**.
2. Find the **Pending** leave application in the list.
3. Click **Withdraw** or **Cancel**.

To check your logs:
1. Navigate to **Attendance > Attendance Info**.
2. Here you can view your **Clock-in/out** timings and **Present/Absent** status.

You can find PF/UAN details here:
1. At the bottom of your **Payslip**.
2. Or go to **Employee > Information > Bank & PF**.
